items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: They played as much on those tin horns as the bugle Sam played on that bugle... That's him with Bugle and Sam, he used to sell waffles.

ctx.x: They played as much on those tin horns as the bugle Sam played on that bugle. Did he play like the old blues?
Absolutely. Did they do that to sort of advertise that they were coming up the street? That's right, yeah.
